result.reason: The redline appropriately extends use rights to Client affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to an M&A successor, but it does not provide that paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable or that subscription licences are terminable only for uncured material breach. It also unnecessarily converts the existing reciprocal affiliate-assignment exception into a Client-only exception, removing TrueLink’s existing right to assign to a financially responsible affiliate and thereby changing unrelated commercial intent. The successor language is generally professional, but the grant could more clearly limit contractor use to use on Client’s behalf.
